articles.summary: United Bank recently named Eric Morales as East regional president. In this role, Morales will direct and oversee the day-to-day banking activities, client relationships, and business developments of the six markets within United’s East Region. This includes the Bank’s Washington, D.C.; Arlington/Alexandria; Fairfax East; Fairfax West; Prince William County/Fredericksburg; and Maryland markets.
articles.title: United Bank Promotes Eric Morales to East Regional President

articles.summary: United Bank hosted its 24th annual Charity Classic golf tournament on Monday in support of Inova Kellar Center, raising $375,000 to support behavioral health services to children, adolescents, and families in Northern Virginia. This year’s event brought the Classic’s lifetime total of funds raised to over $8.8 million.
articles.title: United Bank 24th Annual Charity Classic Raises $375,000 to Support Inova Kellar Center
